name: Universal Effect-Capability ClayCode

effect_model.execution_rule: effect request executes only when current environment supplies a matching non-forgeable capability and release policy accepts it
effect_model.delegation: derived capability scope and verbs must be subsets of parent authority

profiles.FRANK_UNTRUSTED: full language semantics; restricted capability environment; raw/destructive/device effects normally absent unless explicitly approved
profiles.SERVER_SERVICE: filesystem/network/process capabilities declared by deployment manifest
profiles.DESKTOP_GAME: window/input/audio/GPU/filesystem/network capabilities as requested and granted
profiles.BARE_METAL_KERNEL: boot/link/runtime provisioned raw memory/MMIO/IRQ/DMA/device capabilities; no dependency on user-space host

correction_to_CC13.rejected_interpretation: DELETE/FORMAT/RAW_DEVICE are not expressible in model-authored ClayCode
correction_to_CC13.replacement: All operations may be represented as typed effect requests. Safety comes from capability provenance/scope and release validation, not semantic censorship.
correction_to_CC13.retained: FRANK untrusted profile should not receive ambient destructive/raw authority; recoverability remains valuable but not sufficient for safety.

promotion_blockers: other two ClayCode worker contributions not yet fused
no real OS/WASI/native differential application corpus
no end-to-end hostile capability-laundering red team
